Enterprise Core Features

Built for mission-critical operations.

Replace fragmented logging, monitoring, and alerting tools with a single unified telemetry pane.

No-Code / Low-Code Orgs

Event-Driven Failure Remediation

When container memory spikes or microservices become unresponsive, Servora executes canary rollbacks, isolates pods, and routes traffic away before customers notice.

  • ✓ Pre-built triggers for AWS ECS, EKS, and GCP Cloud Run
  • ✓ Custom Webhook and PagerDuty bi-directional sync
  • ✓ Cryptographically signed audit trails for all actions

// Workflow: Auto-Heal Memory Leak

spinReplica({ region: "us-east-1" });

notifySlack({ channel: "#devops-alert" });

}

Zero-Trust Network

Continuous Identity & Perimeter Verification

Every RPC call between services is mutually TLS-authenticated (mTLS) with short-lived ephemeral certificates managed automatically by the Servora daemon.

Zero Secrets in Code

Automated rotation every 60 minutes across all nodes.

AI Incident Commander

Autonomous Root-Cause Synthesis

Instead of drowning in 500 alerting emails during an outage, our LLM engine correlates anomaly spikes and presents the exact commit that introduced the fault.
